news.title: Promax Power Limited (BSE:543375) acquired 63.76% stake in 6.0 MW (AC) solar power project at Hipparagi, Karnataka.
news.body:
Promax Power Limited (BSE:543375) acquired 63.76% stake in 6.0 MW (AC) solar power project at Hipparagi, Karnataka on February 2, 2026. The said acquisition has been undertaken for the purpose of development, ownership and operation of a 6.0 MW (AC) solar power project at Hipparagi, Karnataka, awarded under RESCO mode by Hubli Electricity Supply Company Limited (HESCOM).

Promax Power Limited (BSE:543375) completed the acquisition of 63.76% stake in 6.0 MW (AC) solar power project at Hipparagi, Karnataka on February 2, 2026.
